name: SSH Root & Password Auth Exposure
description: Publicly exposed SSH service with root login permitted and password authentication enabled

findings.title: Root SSH login permitted
findings.why_it_matters: Enables direct brute force attacks against root account

findings.title: SSH password authentication permitted
findings.why_it_matters: Increases credential guessing risk compared to public key auth

findings.title: SSH daemon listening on all interfaces
findings.why_it_matters: SSH exposed to untrusted network traffic
findings.remediation_hint: Restrict SSH to management subnet via firewall

expected_clusters.hypothesis: Publicly exposed SSH port with root login and password authentication permits brute force access
